user.title: Set up Message Hub
user.description: Confirm the setup. Webhooks and further options are managed inside the panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed.

init.title: Options
init.description: Retention, hard cap and log level of the integration.

add_message.name: Add message
add_message.description: Manually adds a message to the message hub.

knx_unavailable.title: KNX integration unavailable
knx_unavailable.description: Message Hub cannot read the KNX bus directly because the HA-KNX integration is not running (or has an old module layout). We fell back to the `knx_event` bus; for telegrams to arrive, you must add a `knx: event:` list with the relevant group addresses to `configuration.yaml`. Recommended: restart or update HA-KNX.

mqtt_unavailable.title: MQTT integration unavailable
mqtt_unavailable.description: Message Hub has MQTT topic subscriptions configured, but the HA-MQTT integration is not running. Set up the MQTT integration so incoming topics show up as messages.

DPT_MISMATCH.title: Inferred datapoint type contradicts project DPT
DPT_MISMATCH.description: Auto-detector inferred {inferred_dpt} from {samples} samples (confidence {confidence}). Project DPT is {project_dpt}. Values are likely decoded incorrectly — please verify the ETS project.

VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: Value outside allowed DPT range
VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: Value {value} is outside the allowed range [{range_min}, {range_max}] for DPT {dpt}. Likely wrong DPT or faulty sensor.

MULTI_RESPONDER.title: Multiple actuators respond on same group address
MULTI_RESPONDER.description: {count} sources answered within {window_ms} ms: {responding_sources}. Likely multiple actuators with the L-flag set — may be intentional for parallel actuators, otherwise verify the ETS topology.

READ_NO_RESPONSE.title: GroupValueRead without response
READ_NO_RESPONSE.description: Read at {read_at} received no response within {timeout_sec} s. Receiver missing, offline, or L-flag not set.

TOGGLE_LOOP.title: Switching loop on DPT 1.001
TOGGLE_LOOP.description: Group address alternates between 0 and 1 (period {period_ms} ms, {cycles} value changes). Likely the same GA is used both sending and listening.

MULTI_TIME_MASTER.title: Multiple time masters on same group address
MULTI_TIME_MASTER.description: {sources} both write to a GA with DPT {clock_dpt}. Duplicate time sources cause drift — configure only one device as time master.

RECONNECT_STORM.title: Reconnect storm after bus silence
RECONNECT_STORM.description: After silence until {silence_until} the source produced a burst: {burst_count} telegrams in the 30s window (normal {normal_avg}, factor {factor}). Typical for reconnect floods after bus power loss.

SEND_CYCLE_DRIFT.title: Send cycle significantly shortened
SEND_CYCLE_DRIFT.description: Recent median Δt {recent_median_dt} s vs. baseline {baseline_median_dt} s — ratio {ratio}. Send cycle halved; likely a changed hysteresis or faulty sensor.

REPEAT_APPROXIMATION.title: Suspected telegram repeats
REPEAT_APPROXIMATION.description: {total_repeats} identical follow-up telegrams with Δt < 100 ms across {period_days} days (~ {repeats_per_day}/day). Approximation of the repeat bit — confirm via xknx tracer (BL-D) when available.
